Ruijie RG-EW3000GX 3000M Wi-Fi 6 Dual-WAN Gigabit Gaming Router

Boost your gaming and home network performance with the Ruijie RG-EW3000GX, a powerful Wi-Fi 6 router featuring dual-WAN support and blazing fast speeds up to 3000Mbps. Designed for gamers and high-demand users, this router offers robust connectivity with dual-band Wi-Fi 6 technology and gigabit Ethernet ports, ensuring seamless streaming, lag-free gaming, and smooth multi-device access.

Key Features:

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax): Next-generation wireless standard delivering faster speeds and improved capacity.
  • Dual-WAN Support: Enables load balancing or failover for increased network reliability and uptime.
  • High-Speed Wireless: Up to 3000Mbps combined speed (2402Mbps on 5GHz + 574Mbps on 2.4GHz).
  • Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Multiple gigabit LAN ports and two WAN ports for flexible, high-speed wired connections.
  • Advanced Technologies: Supports MU-MIMO, OFDMA, and beamforming for efficient multi-device communication.
  • Strong Security: WPA3 encryption, SPI firewall, and DoS attack protection.
  • Easy Management: Intuitive web interface and mobile app for quick setup and network control.

Technical Specifications:

  • Wireless Standard: IEEE 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), backward compatible with 802.11ac/n/g/b/a
  • Frequency Bands: Dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz
  • Maximum Wireless Speed: 3000Mbps (5GHz: 2402Mbps, 2.4GHz: 574Mbps)
  • Ethernet Ports: 4 × Gigabit LAN, 2 × Gigabit WAN
  • Processor: High-performance quad-core CPU (exact specs may vary)
  • Memory: RAM and flash memory optimized for stable operation
  • Security Features: WPA3, WPA2, SPI firewall, DoS protection
  • Antenna: High-gain external antennas for enhanced coverage
  • Beamforming: MU-MIMO beamforming support
  • Other Features: IPv6 support, QoS, guest network, parental controls
  • Power Supply: DC 12V/1.5A (may vary by region)
  • Dimensions: Approximately 230 × 150 × 38 mm
  • Weight: Around 500g
